newsitem.title: USA: ACX sees market gains, ceramics unit strong.
newsitem.headline: ACX sees market gains, ceramics unit strong.

text.p: ACX Technologies Inc said Thursday that demand in the ceramics market "continues to strengthen" its subsidiary Coors Ceramics, while the pulp, paper, power generation and petrochemical markets are expected to see gains.
ACX said in a release that Coors Ceramics "continues to achieve exceptional performance in the ceramic industry, with both revenue and operating income increasing from 1996 fourth quarter levels."
Operating income for Coors' first quarter decreased $1.2 million to $11.4 million, compared to the 1996 year ago quarter, due to lower sales volume, the release said.

Although operating margins declined to 16 percent, compared to 17 percent for the first quarter 1996, they "improved significantly" from the 15 percent margins earned in fourth quarter 1996, Coors Ceramics said.
Coors Ceramics said it experienced growth in the pulp and paper, power generation, and the petrochemical markets.
ACX said demand continues to strengthen in certain markets, with year to year gains expected from the pulp and paper, power generation and petrochemical industries.

ACX Technologies reported first quarter earnings per share of $0.29, before a $0.05 per share charge for exit and severance costs associated with its subsidiary Golden Technologies' high-fructose corn syrup operations.
